skills.description: This skill should be used when browsing or automating web pages that expose tools via the WebMCP API (window.navigator.modelContext). It teaches agents how to discover, inspect, and invoke WebMCP tools on websites instead of relying on DOM scraping or UI actuation.
skills.description_zh: {"answer":"浏览或自动化通过 WebMCP API (window.navigator.modelContext) 暴露工具的网页时使用此技能。它指导智能体发现、检查和调用网站上的 WebMCP 工具，而非依赖 DOM 抓取或 UI 操作。"}
skills.name: WebMCP
